facts.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Network / Mentorship
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Non-dilutive; suggested pay-what-you-can contribution around US$1K
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: High-potential builders without a strict sector requirement; particularly valuable for international founders targeting US customers or a long-term US presence.
facts.Strong-to-Have: An advantage such as previous startup success, deep technical expertise, unique market insight or an influential network.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Core onboarding and in-person activities in SF, plus a year-round online community. Confirm current cohort dates.
facts.Visa / Relocation: A visa letter may be provided for onboarding week.
facts.Application Materials: apply → optional async video → interview → possible 2nd interview。
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-idea–pre-seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: International founders welcome; especially valuable for founders planning US customers or long-term US presence; visa letters for onboarding week.
